data.title: 八重神子 · 神樱月下的宫司花嫁
data.description: 【鸣神大社神樱参道·黄昏】八重神子穿着红白相间的花嫁和装，粉色长发沿着头纱落下，手中捧花像一册新书；她回眸时笑意从编辑部的戏谑变成神明才有的从容温柔。
data.action: 神樱参道捧书卷般的花束回眸，戏谑笑意变成从容温柔
data.lighting: pink twilight under lanterns and falling petals
data.camera: cowboy shot, vertical framing, bouquet and shrine path visible
data.promptProse: Yae Miko turns on the shrine path with the bouquet held in both hands like an open book. Lantern light warms the edge of her veil beneath the pink twilight and falling sakura petals.
data.animaCaption: Both hands hold the bouquet like an open book as she turns beneath the twilight lanterns.
